name: marconi
description: See and use other computers through Marconi: connect, look at the screen, and use the mouse, keyboard and clipboard.
long_description: Marconi connects to other computers (VNC, VNC through SSH, or Marconi's own server). With this extension Claude can connect to the computers you name, take screenshots, click, type and use the clipboard. You can watch by connecting to the same computer with Marconi.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password for the computers Marconi connects to, if they need one. It's kept out of the conversation.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether connected, and the desktop's size and displays

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: See the desktop or part of it

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag from one point to another

tools.name: key
tools.description: Press a key or a combination

tools.name: wait_for_change
tools.description: Wait for the screen to change
